mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 2.5% triggers a preemptive S&P 500 forward return correction over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate rate hikes.
failure_condition: Over a 60-day window, 20-day forward returns do not deviate significantly from the mean of the prior 30-day window (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment momentum as measured by PAYEMS exceeding 130,000 monthly suggests labor market strength that supports equity valuations, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: In regimes with high unemployment, the 60-day forward return is not statistically higher than the 20-day average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both HOUST (industrial production) and RSAFS (retail sales) indicates robust aggregate demand, predicting positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > previous month & RSAFS > previous month
failure_condition: The joint signal is present but 20-day forward returns are negative or flat (Rank IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO below 92.0 (2017=100 index) indicates supply-side contraction, which typically precedes S&P 500 bearishness over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Over 100 test windows, no consistent negative 5-day forward returns when INDPRO is below 92.0 (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains persistently below 1.0% for three consecutive months, it signals accommodative policy sustaining equity risk appetite and positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In tightening regimes, the signal is present but 20-day returns are not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 4.5% suggests weaker wage pressures, which often precedes a 60-day S&P 500 bull run as deflation fears recede.
failure_condition: Over 10 such trigger events, 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than the prior 20-day average (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in both GDPC1 (GDP) and HOUST (production) over a quarter is a leading indicator for positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as confidence in growth rises.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > previous quarter & HOUST > previous quarter
failure_condition: The interaction persists but 20-day returns are flat or negative (Rank IC < 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in both INDPRO and GDPC1 below their 2010 Q4 averages (93.9 and 13277.4 respectively) over the next 5 days predicts S&P 500 bearishness due to contractionary supply conditions.
regime_hint: double contraction in output and demand
failure_condition: The combined signal recurs but 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10).
